verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review setup docs describe a metrics view showing issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time. Those map to findings, acceptance rates, and review coverage. The separate Insights feature measures team developer productivity, and AI reviews can be enabled across the entire organization. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the metrics dashboard aggregates org-wide rather than per repo, coverage shown as a share of PRs rather than a count reviewed, deeper documentation of the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I see dashboards of findings, acceptance rates, and review coverage across my org

citations.quote: which shows metrics like issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time.
